verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB lets you choose where your data lives. You can pick fully managed hosting on AWS, Google Cloud or Azure, or run BYOC inside your own AWS or Google Cloud account, where it states your data never leaves your cloud. This is real control over cloud provider and account-level residency, but the evidence never documents choosing a specific geographic region. Missing for 10: explicit region selection for managed clusters, documented data-residency guarantees or a list of regions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Run ObsessionDB fully managed on AWS, Google Cloud or Azure, or as BYOC inside your own AWS or Google Cloud account
In BYOC, your data never leaves your cloud or your hardware.
